annotation.authors_or_issuer: 국가기술표준원 (Korean Agency for Technology and Standards), KATS
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies safety requirements for industrial robot systems, integration and robot cells across design, installation, operation, maintenance and decommissioning.
Identical (IDT) adoption of ISO 10218-2:2011 as a Korean national standard (KS B ISO 10218-2).
Describes basic hazards and requires elimination or adequate reduction of associated risks.
Excludes process-related hazards such as laser radiation, ejected parts and welding fumes.
annotation.summary_en: Korean national standards portal record for KS B ISO 10218-2, an identical adoption of ISO 10218-2:2011 on safety requirements for industrial robot systems and integration. It lists scope, responsible agencies, cited standards, related technical criteria (Safety Inspection Notice) and revision history (established 2012, reconfirmed 2022).
